title: Designsprache
slide_intent: Separate stable recognition from expressive range so adaptation does not erase continuity.
strategic_value: DB can preserve trust through its core while varying the mix of ingredients for different audiences.
demonstration: Two concept panels compare a factual timeless core with expressive extension; three circular ingredient diagrams show different balances below.
practical_value: Choose the balance of ingredients according to content, audience, medium and application.

content_islands.name: Core and extension
content_islands.spec: Compare the typographic core at left with the illustrated expressive extension at right.

content_islands.name: Range diagrams
content_islands.spec: Place three ingredient-mixture circles beneath, progressing from factual to expressive.

content_islands.name: Context statement
content_islands.spec: Close with the explanation that weighting can change without leaving the shared language.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links the core to trust and recognition and the extension to continued relevance.
reference_purposes.Application: The source explicitly permits changing ingredient weights according to communication context.
